::: {.callout-note title="Historical Connection · 历史背景" icon=false}
In Ancient Egypt, professional scribes used **{{< vocab "hieroglyphics" zh=true >}}** (*"sacred carvings"*) — a sophisticated writing system combining pictorial symbols, ideograms (idea signs), and phonograms (sound signs) to record history, religious beliefs, trade, and royal decrees on **{{< vocab "papyrus" zh=true >}}** and tomb walls. For thousands of years, these symbols remained a mystery until scholars deciphered them in 1822 using the **{{< vocab "Rosetta Stone" zh=true >}}**.

在古埃及，受过专业训练的抄写员（Scribes）使用了象形文字（Hieroglyphics）——一套由图画符号、表意符号和表音符号组成的复杂文字系统，用于在纸莎草纸和神庙石壁上记录历史、宗教、贸易与法老诏令。数千年来这些符号一直是个神秘的谜团，直到学者们利用罗塞塔石碑（Rosetta Stone）才破解了它们的真正含义。
:::

::: {.callout-important title="Your Scribe Challenge · 你的挑战任务" icon=false}
Step into the shoes of an ancient Egyptian scribe! Design your own set of symbolic characters (a modern hieroglyphic system) to represent letters, words, or ideas. Write **2–3 secret sentences** using your symbols in **Part 1**, complete your **Translation Key** in **Part 2**, and then exchange papers with a classmate to see if they can decipher your coded message!
:::

### Assignment Checklist · 学生自查清单

- [ ] **1. Symbol Creation (符号创造):** I created **10–15 unique symbols** representing letters, words, or concepts. *(我创造了 10–15 个独特的符号，分别代表字母、词汇或概念。)*
- [ ] **2. Translation Key (密码对照表):** I fully completed the **Translation Key** in Part 2. *(我已完整填写第二部分的“翻译密码表”。)*
- [ ] **3. Coded Message (符号密文):** I wrote **2–3 complete sentences** in Part 1 using **ONLY** my newly invented symbols. *(我已在第一部分仅使用我创造的符号写下了 2–3 句完整的密文。)*
- [ ] **4. Neatness & Clarity (书写工整):** My symbols are drawn clearly so my partner can accurately distinguish each character. *(我的符号书写清晰规范，方便同伴准确辨认每个字符。)*
- [ ] **5. Peer Deciphering (同学破译):** My classmate successfully translated my secret message, and I verified its accuracy. *(同学已成功写出破译后的译文，且经我核对无误。)*
